cues.text: September 2026. A Grade 5 pupil in Legazpi wakes up with a high fever.
cues.phonemes: sɛptˈɛmbɚ twˈɛnti twˈɛntisˈɪks. ɐ ɡɹˈeɪd fˈaɪv pjˈuːpəl ɪn lɛɡˈɑːspi wˈeɪks ˌʌp wɪð ɐ hˈaɪ fˈiːvɚ.

cues.text: The clinic writes down one thing first: her home address.
cues.phonemes: ðə klˈɪnɪk ɹˈaɪts dˌaʊn wˈʌn θˈɪŋ fˈɜːst: hɜː hˈoʊm ɐdɹˈɛs.

cues.text: But the mosquito that bit her was not at home. It was at school, in the middle of the day.
cues.phonemes: bˌʌt ðə məskˈiːɾoʊ ðæt bˈɪt hɜː wʌz nˌɑːt æt hˈoʊm. ɪt wʌz æt skˈuːl, ɪnðə mˈɪdəl ʌvðə dˈeɪ.

cues.text: Zoom out to Albay.
cues.phonemes: zˈuːm ˈaʊt tʊ ɑːlbˈaɪ.

cues.text: By mid-September, the province had 2,179 cases and 14 deaths, 84 percent more than the year before.
cues.phonemes: baɪ mˈɪdsɛptˈɛmbɚ, ðə pɹˈɑːvɪns hæd tˈuː θˈaʊzənd wˈʌnhˈʌndɹɪd sˈɛvənti nˈaɪn kˈeɪsᵻz ænd fˈɔːɹtiːn dˈɛθs, ˈeɪɾi fˈɔːɹ pɚsˈɛnt mˈɔːɹ ðɐn ðə jˈɪɹ bᵻfˈɔːɹ.

cues.text: The province declared a state of calamity, and schools closed for a week of cleanup.
cues.phonemes: ðə pɹˈɑːvɪns dᵻklˈɛɹd ɐ stˈeɪt ʌv kɐlˈæmᵻɾi, ænd skˈuːlz klˈoʊzd fɚɹə wˈiːk ʌv klˈiːnʌp.

cues.text: Sustainable Development Goal 3 asks us to end epidemics like dengue.
cues.phonemes: səstˈeɪnəbəl dɪvˈɛləpmənt ɡˈoʊl θɹˈiː ˈæsks ˌʌs tʊ ˈɛnd ˌɛpɪdˈɛmɪks lˈaɪk dˈɛŋɡi.

cues.text: Every case is filed by home address, so the brigades go to the homes.
cues.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi kˈeɪs ɪz fˈaɪld baɪ hˈoʊm ɐdɹˈɛs, sˌoʊ ðə bɹɪɡˈeɪdz ɡˌoʊ tə ðə hˈoʊmz.

cues.text: But Aedes aegypti bites by day, where people gather: classrooms, markets, terminals.
cues.phonemes: bˌʌt eɪˈiːdiːz iːdʒˈɪptaɪ bˈaɪts baɪ dˈeɪ, wˌɛɹ pˈiːpəl ɡˈæðɚ: klˈæsɹuːmz, mˈɑːɹkɪts, tˈɜːmɪnəlz.

cues.text: Spray where cases live, and you may spray the wrong barangay.
cues.phonemes: spɹˈeɪ wˌɛɹ kˈeɪsᵻz lˈaɪv, ænd juː mˈeɪ spɹˈeɪ ðə ɹˈɔŋ bɑːɹɑːŋɡˈaɪ.

cues.text: So where is dengue really spreading, and how much control is enough?
cues.phonemes: sˌoʊ wˌɛɹ ɪz dˈɛŋɡi ɹˈiəli spɹˈɛdɪŋ, ænd hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ kəntɹˈoʊl ɪz ɪnˈʌf?

cues.text: This is where MCS comes into play.
cues.phonemes: ðɪs ɪz wˌɛɹ ˈɛm sˈiː ˈɛs kˈʌmz ˌɪntʊ plˈeɪ.

cues.text: Mathematics writes each barangay's day as a matrix: who spends how many hours, and where.
cues.phonemes: mˌæθɪmˈæɾɪks ɹˈaɪts ˈiːtʃ bɑːɹɑːŋɡˈaɪz dˈeɪ æz ɐ mˈeɪtɹɪks: hˌuː spˈɛndz hˌaʊ mˈɛni ˈaʊɚz, ænd wˈɛɹ.

cues.text: Its largest eigenvalue gives the reproduction number, and dengue fades when it falls below one.
cues.phonemes: ɪts lˈɑːɹdʒɪst ˈaɪdʒənvˌæljuː ɡˈɪvz ðə ɹᵻpɹədˈʌkʃən nˈʌmbɚ, ænd dˈɛŋɡi fˈeɪdz wɛn ɪt fˈɔːlz bᵻlˈoʊ wˌʌn.

cues.text: Computing splits that number into shares by place, and ranks the true hotspots.
cues.phonemes: kəmpjˈuːɾɪŋ splˈɪts ðæt nˈʌmbɚɹ ˌɪntʊ ʃˈɛɹz baɪ plˈeɪs, ænd ɹˈæŋks ðə tɹˈuː hˈɑːtspɑːts.

cues.text: Optimisation finds the cheapest brigade plan that brings the number below one, with a certificate that nothing cheaper exists.
cues.phonemes: ˌɑːptɪməzˈeɪʃən fˈaɪndz ðə tʃˈiːpɪst bɹɪɡˈeɪd plˈæn ðæt bɹˈɪŋz ðə nˈʌmbɚ bᵻlˈoʊ wˌʌn, wɪð ɐ sɚtˈɪfɪkət ðæt nˈʌθɪŋ tʃˈiːpɚɹ ɛɡzˈɪsts.

cues.text: On the test network, cases pointed to a residential barangay, but forty-three percent of transmission was at the school and market.
cues.phonemes: ɔnðə tˈɛst nˈɛtwɜːk, kˈeɪsᵻz pˈɔɪntᵻd tʊ ɐ ɹˌɛzᵻdˈɛnʃəl bɑːɹɑːŋɡˈaɪ, bˌʌt fˈɔːɹɾiθɹˈiː pɚsˈɛnt ʌv tɹænsmˈɪʃən wʌz æt ðə skˈuːl ænd mˈɑːɹkɪt.

cues.text: The least-cost plan needed forty percent fewer team-days than spraying everywhere.
cues.phonemes: ðə lˈiːstkˈɔst plˈæn nˈiːdᵻd fˈɔːɹɾi pɚsˈɛnt fjˈuːɚ tˈiːmdˈeɪz ðɐn spɹˈeɪɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪwˌɛɹ.

cues.text: And a CUSUM alarm warned more than a week and a half sooner than a single-week threshold.
cues.phonemes: ænd ɐ kjˈuːsˈʌm ɐlˈɑːɹm wˈɔːɹnd mˈɔːɹ ðˌænə wˈiːk ænd ɐ hˈæf sˈuːnɚ ðˌænə sˈɪŋɡəlwˈiːk θɹˈɛʃoʊld.

cues.text: Twelve results, proven, then verified against independent code.
cues.phonemes: twˈɛlv ɹɪzˈʌlts, pɹˈuːvən, ðˈɛn vˈɛɹᵻfˌaɪd ɐɡˈɛnst ˌɪndᵻpˈɛndənt kˈoʊd.

cues.text: BANTA-Y will not kill one mosquito.
cues.phonemes: bˈɑːntaɪ wɪl nˌɑːt kˈɪl wˈʌn məskˈiːɾoʊ.

cues.text: But it will tell the brigades where the bites really happen, and how much is enough.
cues.phonemes: bˌʌt ɪt wɪl tˈɛl ðə bɹɪɡˈeɪdz wˌɛɹ ðə bˈaɪts ɹˈiəli hˈæpən, ænd hˌaʊ mˈʌtʃ ɪz ɪnˈʌf.

cues.text: Homes tell you where dengue is reported. Places tell you where it spreads.
cues.phonemes: hˈoʊmz tˈɛl juː wˌɛɹ dˈɛŋɡi ɪz ɹᵻpˈɔːɹɾᵻd. plˈeɪsᵻz tˈɛl juː wˌɛɹ ɪt spɹˈɛdz.
